food.sponsor: ZION EVANGELICAL LUTHERAN CHURCH OF KERRVILLE

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Employee record: Signed and Dated Statement for Orientation/Pre-Service training  by trainer and employee: Three out of five staff files evaluated did not have documented preservice training completed.  This was a recite.    The caregivers who were missing documented orientation had been corrected.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee record: Signed and Dated Statement for Orientation/Pre-Service training  by trainer and employee (26 TAC §746.1329(d))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A caregiver failed to actively supervise children while on the playground by exiting the playground twice and having their back to the children while they were climbing/jumping on the playscape.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Employee record: Signed and Dated Statement for Orientation/Pre-Service training  by trainer and employee: Two caregivers were missing documentation of completing pre-service training and three caregivers did not have signature of the trainer who completed the orientation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee record: Signed and Dated Statement for Orientation/Pre-Service training  by trainer and employee (26 TAC §746.1329(d))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): Four caregivers did not have a notarized affidavit on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Gas Leak Inspection: The operation's last gas inspection was conducted on April 9, 2024 and a new gas inspection had not been conducted.    NOTE:  A gas inspection was scheduled for tomorrow during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §746.5405)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care: A copy of the most recent fire inspection was unavailable during the inspection.  The last inspection form was dated 10/15/2024.    NOTE:  The Fire Marshal was contacted during the inspection visit, verified they had been out for an inspection but could not locate the report.  Another inspection was scheduled for Monday.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care (26 TAC §746.801(11))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: One caregiver completed 16 out of 24 annual hours for the evaluation year 7/2025-6/2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: It was observed that a member of the management team physically pulled a child by the arm toward and inside the classroom while the child physically resisted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training: Five out of eleven staff files evaluated had not completed the required 24 annual training hours for their evaluated periods.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Enough Available to Prevent Competition: One classroom observed had the classroom toys kept on top of the cubbies, inaccessible to the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Enough Available to Prevent Competition (26 TAC §746.2505(2))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary: Children have been served burnt biscuits, uncooked oatmeal and bananas that contained growing mold on the stem.  Milk is being stored in classroom mini refrigerators resulting in the milk freezing.  Frozen fruit is not being fully thawed before serving to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary (26 TAC §746.3317)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: One out of ten staff files evaluated had completed 20 out of 24 annual hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Three out of ten child files evaluated did not have updated immunization records on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Four infants, ages 2-9 mos of age did not have a current feeding instruction form on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Water served safe and sanitary: A caregiver and child had similar store-bought water bottles in the classroom.  Due to the water bottles not being labeled properly, a caregiver's water was poured into a child's drink cup.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Water served safe and sanitary (26 TAC §746.3301(f)(2))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: 1 infant bottle and two sippy cups were not labeled with the child's first name and last initial.    NOTE:  This is a re-cite.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: An infant caregiver was observed not changing gloves in between diaper changes and not washing their hands after diapering.  The caregiver used hand sanitizer only.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: Two out of four bottles observed on the counter were not labeled with the child's name for identification.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: Two infant children were observed not having their hands washed after being diapered.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: A classroom initially had 2 caregivers with children ranging in age 2-3yrs,  but when the second caregiver left the room, the specified age group was 2 yrs leaving the room out of ratio.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A school-age child was observed in the staff lounge that is adjacent to the kitchen instead of a classroom.    NOTE:  The child was removed from the space and went home during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: One out of ten child files evaluated was missing updated vaccination records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children responsible for: A 15 month old child was left without supervision on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Four infant feeding plans evaluated for children ages 5 mos, 5 mos, 10 mos, & 10 mos did not have a current plan on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials: A box of baking soda was accessible to children in the bathroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials (26 TAC §746.3407(13))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk: The operation completed an incident report 5 days after the incident occurred.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Two 3 year old children exited the playground and crossed 4 door thresholds resulting in exiting the front of the building into the parking lot without an adult.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: Parent signatures were not obtained for the incident reports completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 1 out of 10 child files evaluated was missing a current vaccination record.  The child is 3 mons of age and is missing their DTaP, IPV and PCV vaccinations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: 5 children were observed sitting in bucket seats to eat breakfast in the infant room and the seat belts were not secured around the children.    NOTE:  This was corrected when the caregiver secured the children in each seat using the available safety straps.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: 3 out of 10 staff files reviewed did not have a CPR certificate on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: 3 out of 10 staff did not have a First Aid certificate on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: An infant caregiver did not wash their hands after diapering a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The last recorded fire drill was conducted on 7/21/22.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: The director was made aware by a parent that there was an allegation a child was potentially placed at risk and did not notify licensing of the concern.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: The operation did not report to licensing within 48 hours that a child who was in care obtained medical attention.    An Administrative Penalty will be recommend as a result of this citation, per HRC 42.078.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))
